Hi volunteers! We’re so glad you’re joining us for the neighborhood book swap this Saturday, 10 a.m.–2 p.m. at the community hall.

You’ll help set up tables, sort books by age group, and welcome visitors. People can bring up to five books and take home as many as they like. There’ll be tea and biscuits in the courtyard, too!

Please wear comfortable shoes, and ask Maya if you need a hand. See you Saturday!
